# Famlo Help Center

> Famlo is a two-sided marketplace for homeschool and family activities.
> Families discover local co-ops, classes and field trips, keep one family
> profile, and register. Organizations list what they offer, schedule
> activities, take bookings and run memberships.

Families use Famlo free. Organizations choose a plan; the fee applies only
to card payments they actually collect and is capped per enrollment.

## Start here

- https://help.famlo.co/docs/intro - What Famlo is, and which guides apply to you
- https://help.famlo.co/docs/families/whats-free-and-whats-paid - What Famlo costs, for families and organizations
